limitations: Source commits in each descriptor are matched to the supplied fixed build identities; presence is source wiring evidence only.
Literal rule-key references passed to helper functions and dynamic branch selectors are listed separately from direct HealSourceCompute calls.

One HealInfo literal can contain one formula but be reused across frames/branches, and generic Bonus rules can serve many heal sources; neither literal count nor call count equals unique source rule count.
No source wiring implies independent game verification.
